EquinoxDao

Professional validator and infrastructure provider operating secure nodes across multiple blockchain ecosystems.

Networks We Are Currently Validating:

- Gno.land (Testnet): test-11, test-13, topaz-1, sapphire-1
- Babylon (Testnet): bbn-test-5
  Validator: bbnvaloper1j6ey72f4k7cvxcv7sr2p4w5lhnfs0ncll2lz27
- Walrus (Mainnet): Aggregator node
  Endpoint: walrus.equinoxdao.xyz:9000
- Namada (Mainnet):
  Validator: tnam1qyawfu5rjgvhezcx0hrj6dkd0g9p97ldlvvtqvwt

Infrastructure & Tools:

- Block explorer covering 76+ Cosmos ecosystem chains: https://explorer.equinoxdao.xyz
- Walrus mainnet aggregator: http://walrus.equinoxdao.xyz:9000

Links to Our Digital Presence:

- Website: https://equinoxdao.xyz
- Explorer: https://explorer.equinoxdao.xyz

Contact Details:

- Email: admin@equinoxdao.xyz
- Discord: kianxxxx

Why We Are Interested in Validating on gno.land:

We believe in gno.land's vision of secure and readable smart contracts powered by the Gno language. Having participated in every testnet iteration from test-11 through sapphire-1, we are committed to supporting network decentralization and the ecosystem's long-term growth toward mainnet.

Contributions & Plans:

Running reliable validator infrastructure across all gno.land testnet iterations, providing RPC endpoints, participating in governance, and supporting the developer community. We bring cross-chain operational experience from Babylon, Walrus, Namada, and the broader Cosmos ecosystem to strengthen gno.land's validator set.

Plans for gno.land:

- Operate a reliable validator with high uptime
- Provide public RPC endpoints
- Create practical guides for node operators
- Support new validators with onboarding

Inter Blockchain Services Dpos validator and top IBC Relayer of COSMOS ecosystem #IBCGANG.

## Networks We Currently Validate

- Axelar - VP: 8M AXL
- AtomOne - VP: 323K ATONE

- TX - VP: 9M TX

## Digital Presence

- https://ibs.team
- https://x.com/IBSvalidator
- https://github.com/Inter-Blockchain-Service
- Discord: @remiinterblockchainservices, @jayinterblockchainservices

Through our community manager, IBS publishes high-quality educational articles to help users, delegators, and ecosystem participants understand blockchain networks, validator operations, and cross-chain infrastructure.

## Contact Details

Private message via Discord or contact@ibs.team

## Motivation & Contributions

Inter Blockchain Services is a long-standing Cosmos infrastructure operator. We are motivated to validate on gno.land by its vision of transparent, sovereign, and community-driven blockchain infrastructure. The network's governance model aligns with how we operate across the ecosystems we support.

IBS will contribute through reliable validator operations and active community engagement. Our community manager produces educational content to help users and delegators understand the networks we support, and we intend to bring the same approach to gno.land.

We have been an IBC relayer since the early days of the protocol and remain among the top five relayers in the Cosmos ecosystem. That experience in cross-chain infrastructure, monitoring, and uptime management is part of what we bring to gno.land.

args:
**1. Validator name**
BonyNode

**2. Networks currently validating & AuM**
Professional node operator since 2017. 22 active validators across 50+ networks
(28+ mainnets, 22+ testnets) on dedicated bare-metal, including AtomOne.
AuM: ~$1M in delegations across all networks, largely from ecosystem developers.

**3. Digital presence**
Gno.land Sapphire explorer (live): https://explorer.bonynode.online/gno
Public Sapphire RPC: https://gno-sapphire-rpc.bonynode.online
Website: https://bonynode.online/ | GitHub: https://github.com/BonyNode
X: https://x.com/bonynode | Telegram: https://t.me/bonynode
Discord: bonynode

**4. Contact**
Email: support@bonynode.online | Telegram: @bonynode | Discord: bonynode

**5. Why we want to validate on gno.land**
We already validate on AtomOne and want to support both sides of the future
AtomOne-Gno.land interoperability path. Gno's realm model and on-chain governance
are also a strong fit for our infrastructure and explorer work.

**6. Contributions to gno.land**
- Public Sapphire block explorer, live and free: https://explorer.bonynode.online/gno
  Built natively on Tendermint2 ABCI (vm/qrender and vm/qfuncs), not as a
  Cosmos-SDK skin. It shows blocks, consensus, active-valset signing statistics,
  GovDAO proposals, the full r/gnops/valopers registry and peer topology.
- Free public Sapphire RPC: https://gno-sapphire-rpc.bonynode.online
- Dedicated bare-metal Sapphire full node with 24/7 monitoring and on-call operations.
- Long-term maintenance of the explorer and RPC as Sapphire evolves, including
  interoperability views when they become available.
